purpose: Primary local inference for single-user Windows assistant; this is selected model configuration, not a running model.

primary_local.version_policy: record resolved model digest and quantization at first installation

notes: Advertised maximum context is not a guarantee of usable context on 16 GB VRAM.
Tool use and vision capability must be wired through the adapter; model selection alone does not implement them.
Cloud inference remains optional and consent-gated; no fallback model is chosen by default.
